title: Quicksort with a pivot partition
summary: Partition a list in place around its final element. Recurse on the smaller partition and iterate over the larger one to bound stack use.
triggers: in-place comparison sort around a pivot
partition values into smaller and larger ranges
prompts: Reorder a buffer of numeric readings in place using a pivot.
Implement a partition sort whose call stack stays small even when partitions are uneven.
invariant: During partition, values before split are smaller than the pivot and values from split up to scan are at least the pivot.
mantra: Place the pivot, then exclude it from both subproblems.
pitfalls: A fixed final pivot can lead to quadratic time on ordered or all-equal input.

anchors.name: Sort an Array
anchors.trick: Partition in place and sort both sides of the settled pivot.

complexity.time: O(n log n) average for random distinct input, O(n²) worst case

mutations.explanation: Skips the first element of the remaining partition.
